facts.fact: The digital ministry and Groupe Sonatel held a week-long workshop, closed by minister Samba Diouf, that structured Sonatel's contribution to the New Deal Technologique and called on other firms to do likewise; the workshop's dates are not given, so the publication date is used.

systems.owner: Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Affairs

note: Class national on the document's own description: the national digital transformation framework covering infrastructure, public administration and the digital economy. It states no adoption, period, cost or report.
